correctionNotes: Use Crinacle/AutoEq Koss KPH40 GRAS 43AG-7 Harman correction as the measured baseline.
Treat the headphone as an open over-ear/on-ear style for X8 form mapping; do not overcorrect sub-bass because fit and pad seal vary strongly.

Because Yaxi pads can change pad distance/seal and often sound a little fuller/smoother than stock foam, reduce the stock AutoEq bass shelf slightly and keep the 5.4 kHz glare cut strong but not over-deadened.
Use ASCII-safe preset names for Luxsin X8 hardware entries.
signature: Open Koss KPH40 used with Yaxi pads; Crinacle GRAS stock KPH40 measurement suggests limited seal-dependent low bass, a strong 5.4 kHz glare region, and presence/treble unevenness. Yaxi pads are treated as a fit/pad preference variant, so bass correction is kept slightly lighter than stock AutoEq.
source: AutoEq crinacle GRAS 43AG-7 Koss KPH40 measured Harman correction; user notes: Yaxi pads and open over-ear style usage. Yaxi-specific measured correction not confirmed, so pad adjustment is conservative preference-layering.
